**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **§ 12.3 (p0044)** is dispositive: nothing restricts us from "developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier," and Vendor expressly acknowledges we have made "no exclusivity … commitment." That satisfies the sole preferred element, so no redline is warranted.
- **§ 7.2 (p0026)** (disclose-and-match before engaging another provider) is a most-favoured-offer/right-to-match mechanic, not a prohibition on using alternatives — it belongs under MFN.
- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** take-or-pay and **§ 12.4 (p0046)** competing-product covenant are minimum-volume and non-compete issues respectively for their own rules; flagging them here would double-count the same commercial terms.
